name: Supplemental Demo B: Mechanical Equipment/VAV Takeoff CSV
description: Count mechanical equipment and VAV boxes by category, type, level, and room/space when present, then export a verified CSV summary.
setup_instructions: Open the known Revit demo model.
Run this supplemental case when the model contains mechanical equipment or VAV boxes.
success_criteria: The raw API total equals the grouped report total.
The result can be rendered as a readable table in the Operator UI.
Missing room/space associations are visible in warnings or grouped output.
failure_criteria: Grouped totals do not match the raw total.
grader_notes: This is a supplemental takeoff benchmark case, not one of the four demo readiness gates.

warnings: 1 mechanical equipment element did not resolve to a room or space.
